title: Pack 2 device-first saved LSD library
notes: Moved saved LSD records into an IndexedDB device database with one canonical record per legal land description.
Automatically migrates existing browser history and LSD notes into the new device database when it is first opened.
Keeps field notes, favourite status, selected disposal, selected surface well, UWI, licensee and saved coordinates together with each LSD.
Tracks first visit, latest visit, total visit count and recent visit history for each saved LSD.
Added Saved LSD search, favourites-only filtering, multiple sort modes and one-tap favourite stars.
Expanded field notes with auto-save status, character count, copy and clear actions.
Added optional nearby-saved-LSD alerts with selectable 0.5, 1, 2 or 5 km radius. Alerts are off by default and only use device location while R5 Atlas is open.
Cached the Pack 2 IndexedDB and saved-location runtime in the PWA shell so saved LSDs remain available after an offline reload.
